acceptanceCriteria: Provide a bounded, secret-screened way to retain multiword and JSON arguments without shell expansion or execution; document exact profile and rollback.
Existing admitted string commands retain compatibility; malformed/oversized/secret/operator cases have focused rejection evidence.
Retain focused tests, independent review, CEM/OCM, verified draft publication and native completion only after approved integration.
body:
https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/408
Observed Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163/public25971. internal/trace/record.go admittedCommandPunctuation and safeCommand intentionally reject quotes, backslashes and JSON punctuation. The GitHub reproduction reports unsupported-verify-syntax for multiword or JSON arguments. This is a concrete missing capability, not evidence that existing safety refusal is incorrect. Dedup search quoted/argv/unsupported-verify-syntax performed. Preserve shell refusal and secret screening; original issue proposes typed argv or bounded literal parsing. Do not execute a verification command merely to record it.
title: GH #408: Trace quoted verification arguments through a bounded argv representation
